article_ref: Producer Responsibility Obligations (Packaging and Packaging Waste) Regulations 2024
title: United Kingdom: packaging producer registration, above threshold
summary: A UK-established business that supplied or imported more than 25 tonnes of packaging in the previous year AND had worldwide turnover of £1 million or more must register with the environmental regulator and report packaging data. Below both thresholds there is no pEPR registration obligation.

required_evidence.label: Proof of registration with the environmental regulator

sources.title: Check if you must comply with EPR for packaging — GOV.UK
sources.note: Thresholds (25 tonnes; £1m turnover; UK-established) read from this guidance on 13 Sept 2026. The statutory instrument reference is NOT yet confirmed and the small-producer tier has lighter duties not modelled here.
